title: Decisions in the product: a project states what acting is worth, the final stage chooses, the page and the intern ask what-if (34.4)
request: The owner asked to finish Phase 10 without stopping. The plan (docs/guides/PHASE10_ABILITIES_PLAN.md, 34.4) asks for the decision core of 34.1 to 34.3 in the product: the solution's decision v2, the engine's final stage, the report, an API, a web page, an intern tool, and Home asking for value and cost in words.
spec: Solution.decision v2 (act, classes); engine _act and _classes; rows for what-if kept beside the project; studio/decision.py behind GET /decision and POST /decision/what-if, the intern's decision_what_if and the Decision page; the report's section; dclab_core.decide.read_spec for Home's words.
plan: map the engine, report, routes, web pages, intern tools and Home with an explorer
Solution.decision v2 with its checks; engine branches; a test on the churn and ticket replicas
keep the out-of-fold rows the decision was chosen on, stamped with the final run, never in a record
one module for the decision view and the what-if; routes, role, event, intern tool
the report's section and the rubric; the web page through DC.client
read amounts from Home's words; ask them once when the action came from the first sentence
product flows, agent suites, a live check with the intern

decisions.decision: Keep the out-of-fold outcomes and scores in the project's own folder, stamped with the final run id
decisions.why: a what-if needs them and must not refit; records, events and the ledger never hold a table's values; a stale file from another run is never read

decisions.decision: One module answers the page, the API and the intern
decisions.why: the same question asked three ways must give one answer; the API test compares it with the core's

decisions.decision: Read amounts only when each clause holds exactly one amount and a word that says what it is
decisions.why: a wrong reading becomes a decision on the built solution; leaving a phrase unread costs only a question

decisions.decision: Ask for the amounts only when the action came from the first sentence and the limit of questions is not reached
decisions.why: the action question already asks what a wrong one costs; asking every conversation broke six tests that guard few questions

decisions.decision: Keep the review path on review_budget
decisions.why: 34.1 tested that the core gives the same answers; moving it would change stored records for nothing

change: dclab_rnd/studio/solution.py (Decision v2); dclab_rnd/studio/engine.py (_act, _classes, save/load_decision_rows, claims); dclab_rnd/studio/decision.py (new); dclab_rnd/agentic/routers/projects.py (two routes); dclab_rnd/accounts/guard.py; dclab_rnd/experience/hooks.py; dclab_rnd/ledger/capture.py; dclab_rnd/intern/tools.py (decision_what_if); dclab_core/report.py; dclab_core/decide.py (read_spec, 0.109.0); dclab_rnd/draft/api.py and chat.py (amounts read and asked); web views/decision.html, core.js, build.py, generated client and static app; scripts/product_e2e.py, browser_e2e.py, model_paths.py; tests/test_decisions_product.py, tests/test_core_decide_words.py (new).

findings.defect: Home never heard the amounts in the product's main flow
findings.scenario: the upload flow says 'a call costs 5 euro; a lost customer costs 300', but the chat had taken the action from the first sentence and summarised before the third answer: no decision
findings.cause: the action question, which asks what a wrong one costs, is skipped when the first sentence says what is done; the costs field is optional and the scripted chat never asked it
findings.fix: the amounts question is asked once when the action came from the first sentence and no amounts were said; its answer is the one source a build adds a decision from
findings.test: scripts/product_e2e.py flow_upload (the decision said in the chat is chosen and a what-if answers)
findings.impact: the decision layer would stay unused for anyone who describes the action in their first sentence
alternatives: read the reply to the summary as amounts: the reply already has other meanings (an edit, build it)

findings.defect: the first version of the costs question broke the rule that Home asks few questions
findings.scenario: asked in every conversation with an action and no amounts: five draft-flow tests and one conversation test expected the summary after the required questions
findings.cause: the question was added whenever the amounts were missing, even when the action question had just asked for costs
findings.fix: narrowed to an action taken from the first sentence, the action question never put, under the limit of five
findings.impact: every Home conversation one question longer

findings.defect: an amount with a thousands separator was read as a decimal
findings.scenario: 'if they leave we lose 1,200 a year' read as a miss costing 1.2
findings.cause: a comma was always taken as a decimal mark
findings.fix: three digits after each comma make a thousands separator; otherwise the comma is a decimal mark
findings.impact: a decision a thousand times too cheap to act on

findings.defect: the live check read the intern's answer from the wrong field
findings.scenario: the intern answered with the core's numbers but the check printed an empty report
findings.cause: a session's answer is in final, not report
findings.impact: a passing live check reported as answering nothing

findings.defect: the words reader turned counts, times and totals into money, and the build added the result to the person's solution
findings.scenario: 'We call the top 100 customers each week, a lost customer costs us about 300' became a call costing 100; '5 minutes', '3 customers a week', '2 million', '1.2m', '.5', '-300', '10.000' and '15 percent' were all read as amounts
findings.cause: any number in a clause with a cost word was taken as money, and the decision was added from the action answer, which invites capacities
findings.fix: a clause needs a money word and no count, time, share or total next to its number; unreadable amounts give nothing; the decision is added only from the answer to the amounts question, as DCLab's own audited move, and amounts heard elsewhere are shown on the Decision page with a confirmed save
findings.impact: a project would choose on how many customers to call from a capacity read as a price, attributed to the person
alternatives: a confirmation question in the chat: one more question for every person who says an amount

findings.defect: a decision that was not drawn covered a cost requirement in the report
findings.scenario: a decision refused with a warning and the requirement 'choose the alert threshold from the cost of a missed churner': marked covered
findings.cause: every path under the decision counted, its warning line too
findings.fix: a decision's warning, assumption and learnable lines never cover a requirement
findings.impact: a report claiming a requirement met that was not

findings.defect: the rows file was written after the holdout was read, unguarded
findings.scenario: a full disk failed the final stage after its record was written, so its holdout read was not counted; a cut file made the decision page answer 500
findings.cause: a plain write and a plain read
findings.fix: written to a temporary file and moved in whole, a failure logged; a broken file read as none
findings.impact: a second holdout read not counted, and a page that fails

findings.defect: one ledger point held two units
findings.scenario: threshold.operating_point stored a share for act decisions and a score threshold otherwise
findings.cause: the same point and state for both
findings.fix: the state says of share or of threshold

findings.defect: decisions were accepted on kinds whose machine never draws one, and a binary cost matrix over the outcome's names failed only at run time
findings.scenario: an uplift project with an act decision showed missing for good; classes no and yes on a binary task were refused by the engine
findings.cause: the solution's checks did not know which kinds draw a decision or how a binary model names its classes
findings.fix: a decision on a kind with its own machine is refused at save; a binary cost matrix names 0 and 1 or the outcome's own values with the positive one, mapped by the engine
findings.impact: a decision promised and never drawn

findings.defect: test servers left store runs writing into the owner's store
findings.scenario: five store runs, parent launchd, on deleted temporary folders, one holding the store's write lock (reported by the collector's session)
findings.cause: the scripts' servers kept the worker's store loop on, and the run outlives a killed server
findings.fix: every scripted test server turns the store, collector and student loops off; a store run stops when its parent or its folder is gone
findings.impact: test records mixed into the training store
findings.open: the five running processes are the owner's to stop

findings.defect: the browser test never showed a stated decision
findings.scenario: the flow's project states none, so the Decision page was checked only for its empty state
findings.cause: the check read whatever the flow's project held
findings.fix: a check of its own: a decision said in the chat, chosen by the final stage, its page's sentence and curve, and a what-if typed into the form against the API's answer
findings.impact: the page's chosen-decision view and its form were untested in a browser

findings.defect: the browser test left its server running and failed after every check passed
findings.scenario: a job still running in the server when the test ended: terminate did not stop it within ten seconds
findings.cause: the teardown waited once and raised
findings.fix: kill the server when it does not stop in time
findings.impact: a green run reported as failed, and a server left on a port

findings.defect: a person could state a decision only as raw JSON or in the chat
findings.scenario: the setup wizard's solution step had no decision fields; the Solution page edits the decision as JSON
findings.cause: 34.4 wired the decision through the engine, the API, the page and the chat, not the wizard
findings.fix: a decision block in the wizard's step 3 for a yes/no outcome: what is done to a row, what a case found is worth (a number or a value column), what an action, a miss and a wasted action cost, a capacity; amounts said in the chat fill it in (the proposal carries them); a decision set on the Solution page of another kind is kept
findings.test: scripts/browser_e2e.py (flow: the decision stated in the wizard is chosen); scripts/product_e2e.py (the proposal carries the chat's amounts)
findings.impact: most people would never state a decision
alternatives: fields on the Solution page only
findings.open: the Solution page still edits the decision as JSON

findings.defect: amounts typed in the wizard vanished when the columns were audited again
findings.scenario: a person fills the decision, then edits the prediction moment: the audit redraws the sheet
findings.cause: the redraw kept the ticks of other rows but not the new fields
findings.fix: once touched in this draft, the fields are restored after every redraw; untouched, the new proposal's heard amounts fill them
findings.test: scripts/browser_e2e.py (flow edits the moment after filling the decision)
findings.impact: a decision silently lost before the build

findings.defect: amounts typed while an audit ran were still lost
findings.scenario: a screenshot script typed while the target's audit was in flight
findings.cause: the fields were read when the audit began, before the typing
findings.test: scripts/browser_e2e.py (flow); a screenshot of step 3 at 1280 and 375 px
findings.impact: the same loss under a slow audit

findings.scenario: three columns in the sheet's value column cut the action's text and let the value-column list overflow its cell
findings.cause: a grid sized for a full-width panel
findings.fix: the action on its own line, the amounts in two columns, the list at full width
findings.test: a screenshot at 1280 and 375 px, no sideways scroll
findings.impact: hard to read and to fill

findings.defect: a browser check added in the last commit broke a unit test
findings.scenario: test_web_client lists the browser checks; the new check 'decide' was not in it
findings.cause: the commit ran the browser suite but not the unit tests that read its list
findings.impact: a red test on main for an hour

measurements.name: the decision through the product, scripted
measurements.gate: the churn replica's act decision chosen and read once; the saved rows reproduce the choice; the API's what-if equals the core's; the ticket replica's cost matrix costs no more than the likeliest class; the product's upload flow chooses the decision said in the chat
measurements.result: all held; the upload flow called 82.6% of customers at 5 a call and 54.4% at 50
limits: the page was not looked at in a browser: Playwright's browser is not installed

measurements.name: the intern answers a what-if, live
measurements.gate: the intern calls decision_what_if and answers with the core's numbers, within EUR 0.5
measurements.result: two what-if calls; 34.2% instead of 81.5% at 30 a call, 10.25 per row, the old list 6.56, regret 3.69, the core's numbers; EUR 0.103
limits: it rounded the sensitivity's switch point instead of quoting the table's own

measurements.name: the Decision page in Chromium (make browser-test, 8 checks)
measurements.gate: every check passes at 1280 and 375 px; the page's what-if share equals the API's within 0.0006
measurements.result: 8 of 8 checks pass; the decision acts on 84.8% of rows, at 50 a call the page and the API both act on 55.8%
limits: no model: the chat asks its standard questions

outcome: A project can say what acting on a row is worth and costs, in a form or in words; the final stage chooses on how many rows to act with its interval, the report says it, and the page, the API and the intern answer what-if with one answer.
lessons: Run the product's main flow end to end: unit tests passed while the chat never asked for the amounts.
A question added to a conversation is a cost to every person: put it where the existing questions left a gap.
Read a person's numbers only when the words leave no doubt; a refused reading is cheap, a wrong one is a wrong decision.
A reader that guesses is worse than one that refuses: every number must say it is money before it is read as money.
A page that redraws itself must carry every field a person typed, not only the ones that existed when the redraw was written: test it by changing what triggers the redraw after filling the form.
After adding a browser check, run the unit tests that read the browser script too: a list of checks is a contract.
risks: a wrong amount read from words becomes the built solution's decision
the rows kept for what-if go stale when the final stage reruns
